text: Overcurrent and feeder protection – SIPROTEC 7SJ82 | Siemens

The SIPROTEC 7SJ82 is an overcurrent protection device for feeders, lines and capacitor banks in medium- and high-voltage systems. It provides powerful protection functions to provide cost-effective safety for your electrical equipment. The device offers future-oriented solutions with its flexibility and the powerful DIGSI 5 engineering tool for protection, control, and automation.
